title: Tool 71 — DLT Smart Contract Guardrail Builder
description: Programmable settlement logic guardrail generator. Input spend caps, counterparty allowlists, settlement windows, escalation triggers, and N-of-M approval requirements. Generates Policy Mandate JSON, Solidity stub (Besu), Kotlin CorDapp stub (Corda), and SVG approval workflow DAG. Client-side. Works offline. Zero PII.
